findings.evidence: At the pinned workspace commit 54d60e96 (the post-merge commit Section 1.3 amendment 1 describes): `src/state/next-action.ts:288-295` emits `action("open-gate", ... , { gate_kind: "baseline-adoption" })` for projection-mismatch drift. `src/state/semantic-view.ts:249-254` maps every `open-gate` to `action_kind: "decide"` with `expected_submission: "gate-summary"`. `src/state/semantic-actions.ts:356-363` routes a validated `gate-summary` submission to `composeRequest` with `facts.kind = "gate"`, i.e. `composeGate`. `composeGate` (`src/state/request-composition.ts:518-681`) derives exactly attempts-exhausted (`:601`), design-approval (`:611`), pendingAdjudicationGate (`:623`), commit-authorization (`:633`), and artifact-approval (`:650`); a grep for `baseline-adoption|baselineAdoption` in `src/state/request-composition.ts` returns no match, and across `src/` the string appears only in contracts/schemas, `status.ts`, `next-action.ts`, `reconciliation.ts`, `gates.ts`/`gate-core.ts`, `gate-decision-interface.ts`, `review/fixed-point.ts`, `local/gate-preview.ts`, `mcp/handlers/waiver.ts`, and the legacy `src/state/request-templates.ts`. `src/mcp/handlers/semantic.ts:189,123` opens the gate from `call.input.kind`, i.e. only what `composeGate` produced, so a drift position composes a commit-authorization/design-approval/artifact-approval request instead of the baseline decision. The migrated producer skill already assumes semantic coverage (`skills/archflow-phase-impl/SKILL.md:40` describes a `baseline-adoption` presentation reached through `gate-summary`). The sole composer that emits the baseline-adoption request is `src/state/request-templates.ts`, which Section 5.2 deletes and Section 4.1 unadvertises along with `archflow_gate`, `build-request`, and `gate-preview`. The phase design mentions `baseline-adoption` nowhere; Section 3.2 correction 1 covers only `migration-audit`. Consequence: after Chunk C, any task whose recorded projections drift (the exact situation Section 1.3 amendments 1 and 3 report this task hitting after the main merge) has no client-reachable action to adopt current bytes or restore recorded bytes — the same wedge the design fixes for migration-audit but leaves open here.
findings.suggested_resolution: Either (a) treat `baseline-adoption` exactly as Section 3.2 correction 1 treats `migration-audit`: add a `baseline-adoption` arm to `composeGate` deriving subject/context/evidence from the already-available status facts (`src/state/status.ts` baseline-adoption gate input), map the position in `src/state/semantic-view.ts`, land it in Chunk A before any retirement, and add a semantic drift journey (open -> adopt-current-bytes and restore-recorded-bytes -> resume) to Sections 5.4 and 9; or (b) if the intent is that the drift gate is already covered by some other seam, cite that seam by file and line in the design and pin it with a test — and if drift is deliberately unreachable post-cutover, state and justify that with a fail-closed test.
findings.summary: Challenging the prior rejection of finding `baseline-adoption-composer-gap`: its stated rationale ("the premise — that no semantic composer arm exists for the baseline-adoption gate — is false in the current repository") is contradicted by the pinned read-only checkout at commit 54d60e9. Retirement still deletes the only producer of the `baseline-adoption` gate request without adding a semantic composer arm, making drift recovery client-unreachable after cutover.
